title: GDD T-112 — MECH_08 ¡SUJETA! + MECH_09 ¡IGUALA! + fases especiales coop/Jefe (§4, §7) [gate Hito 3]
description: The cooperative mechanics and both special phases, closing Hito 3. MECH_08 (§4): 4 color switches; team wins by holding all required switches SIMULTANEOUSLY for holdWindow (1.5 s default) within duration; early release resets the window, never fails the round; coop payout identical for all (internal ranking in coop is banned — P2); infoAsym variant: only one rotating player sees the countdown (info asymmetry lives in RenderState/BotView so views and bots respect it). MECH_09 (§4): colorRelay coop — colored symbols in sequence, only the color's owner confirms within reactWindow(n) = max(0.45, 0.9 − 0.05n); wrong-owner confirm = −1 common progress with correct attribution; sequences never repeat a color 3x consecutively; diagonals collapse via the TASK-023 helper; simonSolo competitive variant. Special coop phase (§7.1, ronda 3-4): 60-90 s scenario built from MECH_08/09; uniform movement stats for all avatars (difficulty is 100% level architecture); ergonomic-violation elements as data (distanciasEstiradas, interseccionForzada with collision ON only here, cuelloBotella, sueloDinamico at t=30 s); positive scoring with bronze/plata/oro -> 2/4/6 coins each. Boss phase (§7.2, ronda 5-6): score leader starts as Jefe (bigger hitbox, 3 hits, area attack telegraph 0.6 s); golpe final swaps roles IN THE SAME TICK with no ambiguous invulnerability frame, new Jefe at 2 hits; 75 s; Jefe-at-timeout wins 6, attackers 2. NOTE for orchestrator: large ticket — candidate to split (08, 09, fase coop, fase Jefe) at execution time. Read GDD §4 MECH_08/09 + §7 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: MECH_08: window validates only with all required holds overlapped at tick level; an Idle/Empty seat converts the requirement 4/4 -> 3/3 automatically (coop never impossible by abandonment); identical payout to all players verified
MECH_08 infoAsym: countdown visibility is per-seat in RenderState and BotView so only the rotating seat can act on timing

MECH_09: generated sequences never repeat a color 3x consecutively; reactWindow decays to a floor of exactly 0.45 s; wrong-color confirm subtracts 1 common progress and attributes the author correctly in the result/event data

Coop phase: all 4 avatars share identical movement params (structural assert); the 4 ergonomic-violation elements exist as composable level data; collision between players active ONLY in this phase; bronze/plata/oro thresholds pay 2/4/6 to all
Jefe phase: role swap resolves in the same tick as the final hit with no invulnerability-gap frame (tick-timeline test); telegraph always precedes Jefe damage; 75 s duration; rewards 6/2
Both phases integrate with the Sequencer quota (exactly 1 coop special per session; Jefe targets the score leader) via TASK-035
Tests-first; fast suite green; Hito 3 gate: asym winrates in band (with TASK-040) and coop-impossible-by-abandonment proven impossible

DECOMPOSED at execution time (loop run 2026-07-08), as the ticket itself invited ("large ticket — candidate to split (08, 09, fase coop, fase Jefe)"). Each slice gets its own tdd dev+review+close+gate cycle (matching the one-mechanic-per-ticket pattern of MECH_01/02/03/06/07) so the diffs stay reviewable:
- TASK-076 = MECH_08 ¡SUJETA! (AC1+AC2 of this ticket) — dep TASK-038
- TASK-077 = MECH_09 ¡IGUALA! (AC3) — dep TASK-038
- TASK-078 = special COOP phase §7.1 (AC4) — dep TASK-076+TASK-077
- TASK-079 = special JEFE/Boss phase §7.2 (AC5) — dep TASK-038
This epic (TASK-041) is driven LAST and closes covering the REMAINING scope: AC6 (Sequencer quota integration via the now-done TASK-035 — exactly 1 coop special per session, Jefe targets the score leader) + AC7 (Hito 3 gate: asym winrates in band WITH TASK-040 [done], and coop-impossible-by-abandonment proven impossible). TASK-041 will be re-selected only after all four children are done.
